_help: One file can hold several kinds of content at once. These are the section names you can use: feats, backgrounds, species, subclasses, classes, spells, items, keywords, creatures. Entries reference each other by id, so a feat here can grant a spell defined in the same file.

spells.name: Hearth Glow
spells.description: An object you touch sheds warm light in a 20-foot radius and keeps you comfortable in cold weather.

feats.name: Keeper of the Flame
feats.description: You know the Hearth Glow cantrip (Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it) and have Resistance to Cold damage.
